content: मदः [मद्-अच्] .²1 Intoxication, drunkenness, inebriety; मदेनास्पृश्ये <ls>Dk.</ls>; मदविकाराणां दर्शकः <ls>K. 45</ls>; see <ab>comps.</ab> below. .²2 Madness, insanity. .²3 Ardent passion, wanton or lustful passion, lasciviousness, lust; इति मदमदनाभ्यां रागिणः स्पष्टरागान् <ls>Śi. 10. 91</ls>. .²4 Rut, ichor, or the juice that exudes from the temples of an elephant in rut; मदेन भाति कलभः प्रतापेन महीपतिः <ls>Chandr. 5. 45</ls>; so मदकलः, मदोन्मत्त; <ls>Me. 20</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 7</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 102</ls>. .²5 Love, desire, ardour. .²6 Pride, arrogance, conceit; तं मोहाच्छ्रयते मदः स च मदाद्दास्येन निर्विद्यते <ls>Pt. 1. 240</ls>. .²7 Rapture, excessive delight. .²8 Spirituous liquor; पाययित्वा मदं सम्यक् <ls>Śukra. 4. 1171</ls>. .²9 Honey. .²10 Musk. .²11 Semen virile. .²12 Soma. .²13 Any beautiful object. .²14 A river (नद.) .²15 Beauty; नीलारविन्दमदभङ्गिमदैः कटाक्षैः <ls>Bv. 3. 4</ls>. .²16 <ab>N.</ab> of the 7th astrological mansion. .{@-दी@} .²1 A drinking-cup. .²2 Any agricultural implement (such as a plough <ab>&c.</ab>).
